reel.topic: Myth vs Fact: AI bots need constant monitoring
reel.ui_a: Sure, I’ve scheduled a review. I’ll send a draft by Thursday.
vo: Clients are tired of waiting hours for a response.
You think AI bots need constant supervision.
A client messages, the bot replies instantly.
The draft is scheduled, you approve with one click.
Updates flow to Calendar, Email, and your CRM.
Your firm stays open 24/7, no missed requests.
reel.insight_note: Law and accounting firms often fear AI needs constant oversight, so busting that myth drives adoption.
reel.caption:
Clients are tired of waiting hours for a reply, and you worry AI bots need a babysitter. The fix? An intelligent bot that books, drafts, and updates your tools instantly. Today, set up a simple auto‑reply in your email that acknowledges client requests and adds them to your calendar—no code needed. Save this reel and share it with a partner who still handles intake manually. DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15‑min call.
